purpose: Materialize a casewise REF-HIGH authority for the later equal-error cost experiment using the independently diagnosed integrated-invariant Reference convergence policy, without executing RossFast or timing.
epistemic_status: P2E20 is a formal construction/qualification workunit, not an independent confirmation of P2E19. The scaled-policy behavior was already observed in P2E19 and is used prospectively to define the reference algorithm.

case_matrix.case_order: material major, then effective_saturation, then forcing

reference_policy.balance_rate_tolerance_formula: 1.6e-15 / dt_day for both compartment and total balance convergence criteria

fine_refinement_levels.ref_high_endpoint: 32-substep endpoint for a case that passes all casewise qualification rules

stability_budget.storage_budget: full exact-Se P2E14 storage envelope because it is already at machine-scale summation resolution

casewise_qualification.route_rule: all 8, 16 and 32-substep Reference trajectories must complete and every accepted substep must pass hard route validity
casewise_qualification.stability_rule: both 8-vs-16 and 16-vs-32 endpoint comparisons must pass every frozen head, theta and storage budget

stability_unresolved_cases.known_diagnostic_reason: 8-vs-16 storage delta exceeded the machine-scale storage floor in P2E19

expected_reproduction_from_p2e19.rule: A mismatch with this expected reproduction is retained as a construction discrepancy and blocks use of the affected case; do not retune the policy.

future_equal_error_boundary.reference_reconstruction_in_future_timin: The same frozen 32-substep Reference policy may be recomputed outside timed regions rather than timing REF-HIGH itself.
future_equal_error_boundary.unresolved_cases: may not enter an equal-error solver-performance claim unless a later independent Reference authority is established

outcome_policy.if_33_case_reproduction: Persist the casewise REF-HIGH set and permit a separately preregistered equal-error solver-control/performance experiment on those qualified cases.
outcome_policy.if_fewer_cases_qualify: Persist the smaller qualified set and reassess whether it remains scientifically representative before timing.
outcome_policy.if_more_cases_qualify: Persist the observed result but do not automatically add previously unresolved cases to performance; central governance must reconcile why the construction differs from P2E19.

next_permitted_action: Execute only the Reference-only 8/16/32 construction on all 36 cases. RossFast and performance timing remain forbidden.
